prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
[g] Live-run the Bluehaze posting cycle on @tester.bluehaze.test: post with exact text + generated image, then delete only that post.

[a]
1. Generated `./cover.png` (workspace root) with Pillow: 1200x675 RGB, white bold "Harbor Day 2026" centered on dark blue; verified size via `Image.open` → `(1200, 675)`.
2. Used the New Post dialog: filled the exact text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, uploaded cover.png via the Upload image control, set alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` in the Add alt text dialog, published.
3. Deleted via that post's options menu → Delete post → confirm Delete. Only that post's menu was opened; no other post was touched.

[r]
- Publish confirmed live: toast "Your post has been published", post at top of feed with the poster rendering the title legibly; accessibility tree showed `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."` and editor value byte-exact.
- Deletion confirmed after a full page reload: `document.body.innerText` check returned `newPost:false, oldPost:true, postCount:7`; feed screenshot matches the pre-test state (Bench Tester's Oct 23 post and all other users' posts intact, same order).
- Assumptions: alt text applied via the app's own alt-text dialog (no other field existed); "only that post" enforced by targeting the first feed item, which was the new post, and verifying by reload.
- Browser tab closed; only the launched browser's tab was opened and closed.

[next] Nothing pending; uploader cycle verified end to end.
